message.content:
Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most highly‑rated and widely‑praised crime‑thriller films released in 2020:

| # | Title | Release Date (US) | Director | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|-------------------|----------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Invisible Man** | 12 Feb 2020 | Leigh Whannell | A modern, psychological take on the classic horror trope, blending suspense with social commentary on abuse and gaslighting. |
| 2 | **The Gentlemen** | 27 Mar 2020 | Guy Ritchie | Ritchie's signature fast‑paced, witty storytelling, featuring an ensemble cast and a plot full of double‑crosses and sharp dialogue. |
| 3 | **The Irishman** | 11 Apr 2020 (limited) | Martin Scorsese | Though more of a crime epic, its intricate narrative structure and deep character studies make it a standout thriller. |
| 4 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | 18 Jun 2020 | Aaron Sorkin | A courtroom drama that doubles as a tense thriller, with razor‑sharp dialogue and a powerful performance by a star‑studded cast. |
| 5 | **The Hunt** | 20 Jun 2020 | Thomas Vinterberg | A chilling thriller about a man falsely accused of child abuse, exploring themes of paranoia and societal judgment. |
| 6 | **The Nightingale** | 24 Jul 2020 | Jennifer Kent | A gritty, atmospheric thriller set in colonial Australia, known for its intense performances and stark cinematography. |
| 7 | **The Last Duel** | 30 Aug 2020 | Ridley Scott | A historical crime‑thriller that blends medieval intrigue with a modern sense of justice and moral ambiguity. |
| 8 | **The Little Things** | 15 Oct 2020 | John Lee Hancock | A tense, slow‑burn thriller featuring a cat‑and‑mouse chase between two detectives, with strong performances by Denzel Washington and Rami Malek. |
| 9 | **The Devil All the Time** | 23 Nov 2020 | Antonio Campos | A bleak, atmospheric thriller that follows a series of interconnected crimes across rural America, noted for its haunting tone. |
|10 | **The Midnight Sky** | 25 Dec 2020 | George Clooney | While primarily a sci‑fi drama, its thriller elements—survival, isolation, and moral dilemmas—make it a compelling watch. |

These films were praised for their direction, performances, and the way they kept audiences on edge. If you’re looking for a mix of psychological tension, action, and complex storytelling, any of these should satisfy your craving for a crime‑thriller.
